dx_friction: Auth is a single X-Api-Key header; only extra step is resolving the project name to a UUID via the tracer-sessions API. Traces and runs use the v2 query endpoints with a small function-style filter DSL (eq/and/or/gt/has/search) -- expressive for filtering but no server-side arbitrary expressions; aggregates come from the separate fixed-shape /runs/stats endpoint. Cursor pagination uses next_cursor. Rate limit of 10 req/10s forces client-side throttling in any script. Malformed filter 'eq(' returned HTTP 400 with a structured error body.
